title: Zero-polynomial testing in polynomial-time coRP
statement: The language of encodings of nonempty, well-formed arithmetic circuits over the integers that compute the zero polynomial belongs to coRP for the polynomial-time verifier model. Equivalently, there is a polynomial-time randomized verifier that rejects every such zero circuit with certainty and accepts every string outside this language with probability at least $2/3$.
